# Synthetic fixture only

synthetic_events.json contains seven invented software-test records, not BOTS V3
logs or real attack evidence. All records carry synthetic=true. IP addresses use
RFC 5737 documentation ranges. Default filtering retains six records (EventIDs
1, 3, 11) and excludes one EventID 13 record. Do not mix this fixture with a
real-data experimental database or infer detection metrics from its results.
